title: Canon EOS 5D Mark IV 30.4MP Full-Frame Professional DSLR (Best Professional DSLR)
purpose: The iconic industry-workhorse professional full-frame DSLR ('Best Professional DSLR'): 30.4MP Full-Frame CMOS sensor with Dual Pixel CMOS AF and Dual Pixel RAW, DIGIC 6+ processor, 61-point High-Density Reticular AF II (41 cross-type points), 7 fps continuous speed, and legendary Canon L-series skin tone color science.

sensor_and_optics.sensor_type: 36.0 x 24.0mm Full-Frame CMOS sensor with Dual Pixel CMOS AF & Dual Pixel RAW (30.4MP, 6720 x 4480)
sensor_and_optics.lens: Canon EF 85mm f/1.4L IS USM (14 elements in 10 groups, Air Sphere Coating, 9-blade circular aperture, 4-stop optical IS)
sensor_and_optics.iso_base: ISO 100 native base sensitivity (ISO 100–32,000, expandable to L:50 and H2:102,400)
sensor_and_optics.dynamic_range: 13.6 EV dynamic range with Canon Dual Pixel RAW micro-contrast and signature warm human skin color matrices
sensor_and_optics.shutter: 1/8000s to 30s weather-sealed focal-plane shutter, 1/200s flash sync, 7 fps continuous burst

lighting_and_exposure.primary_lighting: Professional studio strobe, off-camera softbox, or golden-hour editorial backlight calibrated to ISO 100
lighting_and_exposure.light_transport: Signature Canon full-frame color transport: warm, luminous subsurface skin scattering, smooth highlight roll-off on cheekbones and bridal silk, and clean shadow separation

surface_rendering: 30.4MP full-frame CMOS resolving authentic epidermal skin texture, fine vellus hair, eyelashes, and luxury textile weaves with Canon's renowned flattering skin warmth
Dual Pixel RAW micro-resolution acuity with natural local contrast and zero harsh digital edge ringing
Canon L-series fluorite and Air Sphere Coating (ASC) optical purity suppressing veiling flare and ghosting in backlit portraits
depth_and_optics: 61-point High-Density Reticular AF II (41 cross-type points) with 150,000-pixel RGB+IR metering locked on the near eye
Classic full-frame L-series three-dimensional subject isolation with creamy, rounded 9-blade bokeh transitions
Natural rectilinear full-frame geometry with zero wide-angle facial distortion

execution_directive: Enforce Canon EOS 5D Mark IV 30.4MP Full-Frame professional DSLR optical authority with Canon EF L-series glass, Dual Pixel RAW acuity, and signature warm Canon editorial skin color science.
